summary: Reads an entry count from this[0x130] and an array pointer from this[0x134], then iterates over that many entries (each 316 bytes apart), calling the unregistered helper 0x004FB5D0 with a pointer to each entry. Returns the entry count. When the count is not positive, the loop body never runs and the count is returned unchanged.

operations.description: Load the entry count from this[0x130] as the result and loop bound.
Guard: proceed only when the count in this[0x130] is greater than zero.
do-while loop visiting each array entry, incrementing the visit counter until it reaches the stored count.
Call the unregistered helper 0x004FB5D0 with a pointer to the current entry (base this[0x134] plus index times stride).
Advance the entry pointer by the 316-byte stride for the next iteration.
Return the entry count (re-read from this[0x130] after the loop).

unresolved: The helper 0x004FB5D0 is undocumented (FAILNODOCENTRY); its effect per entry is unknown.
The element type of the this[0x134] array and the meaning of the 316-byte stride are caller-defined.
The owning type of this object and the semantic role of the count field this[0x130] are not established.
